### Context

Opening `/widgets/` locally showed page not found (404). In a local test, ignoring the final slash made the page load. Nothing was blocked.

### What is broken

Opening `/widgets/` shows page not found (404) instead of the widgets page. `/widgets` loads normally.

### Why it is broken

The part that matches web addresses to pages compares them character for character. The extra final slash means no page matches. Ignoring the slash in a local test turned the 404 into a successful load.

### How to fix it

Remove a final slash from the address before comparing it, so `/widgets/` and `/widgets` reach the same page. Add a test that repeats the failing request to check it stays fixed. The change touches one comparison. Choose hotfix because the fix is one small, contained change.
